HTX, formerly Huobi, disclosed a cyberattack on 2023-11-22 after unauthorized transfers drained exchange hot wallets on Ethereum during the broader HECO Bridge compromise. Public reporting and onchain observations tied the exchange-side Ethereum losses to compromised operational wallet authority rather than a smart contract flaw, with commonly cited losses around $13.6 million. Available evidence indicates that attacker-controlled transactions were signed from HTX hot wallets during the broader HECO Bridge incident on 2023-11-22. Public disclosures and transaction patterns support a private key compromise or compromise of wallet management infrastructure.…
